baseline.proxy_byte_definition: Encrypted TLS bytes in PolicyRelay SendData commands after admission; excludes CONNECT, TCP overhead and acknowledgement. Not a delivery guarantee.

protected_proxy.proxy_byte_definition: Encrypted TLS bytes in PolicyRelay SendData commands after admission; excludes CONNECT, TCP overhead and acknowledgement. Not a delivery guarantee.

idle_revocation.timing_scope: Observation after sequential functional controls; not an exact close timestamp or scheduling deadline.

not_covered: Native browser/DNR header or cookie sanitation
Application-encrypted or arbitrary compressed identity extraction
residual: Proxy-only protection leaves first-party URL, header, body and WebSocket identities linkable.
scope: Controlled HTTP/1.1 and bounded WebSocket frames over the original owned-origin TLS certificate, through the real proxy.
